description: This file contains image processing utilities including image metadata extraction, resizing, format conversion, and EXIF orientation normalization, with fallback mechanisms between 'sharp' and 'sips' depending on environment conditions.

methods.name: buildImageResizeSideGrid
methods.description: Generates a sorted array of resize sides based on maximum allowed size and starting point.

methods.name: getImageMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves image dimensions and metadata, using sharp or sips depending on environment.

methods.name: normalizeExifOrientation
methods.description: Adjusts image buffer to correct orientation based on EXIF data, using sharp or sips.

methods.name: resizeToJpeg
methods.description: Resizes an image buffer to a JPEG with specified max side and quality, normalizing orientation first.

methods.name: convertHeicToJpeg
methods.description: Converts HEIC images to JPEG format, using sharp or sips.

methods.name: hasAlphaChannel
methods.description: Checks if an image buffer has an alpha (transparency) channel.

methods.name: resizeToPng
methods.description: Resizes an image buffer to PNG format, preserving transparency, with optional compression level.

methods.name: optimizeImageToPng
methods.description: Optimizes PNG images by resizing and adjusting compression to meet a byte size limit.
